_comment: Coverage floors (#532/#587). Up-only under test:ratchet. Floors move to two points below a level sustained for three runs; absolute floor-lag remains visible in the report.
approvedDeviation: #801 remaps coverage scope keys from retired packages (protocol/blob-format/time-engine/gateway/app-engine/automation/agent-runtime) onto packages/core/src/{protocol,blob,time} and packages/server/src/{engine,automation,acp} plus the former-gateway dir brace; every numeric floor is unchanged. Prior: @vitest/coverage-v8 4 (#565) made AST-aware remapping the only mode, redefining what counts as a branch (optional chaining, nullish coalescing, default params, nested arrows). This is a MEASUREMENT change, not lost coverage — proven by packages/tunnel, packages/backup, packages/agent-runtime and packages/cli, which have ZERO source or test changes vs origin/main yet all moved (tunnel branches 80 -> 52.67). Local and CI agree within 0.06pt, so it is deterministic, not runner variance. Branch floors re-seed ~1pt under the newly measured values; the vault/tunnel/cli LINE floors move 1-3pt for the same reason. NOT re-seeded downward: packages/design lines TIGHTENS 90 -> 98, because #565 added packages/design/src/css.test.ts covering toCss(), which had 0/32 lines and no test anywhere in the repo — that gap, not the remap, was the entire design-tokens lines miss (66.01 -> 99.03). Issue #630 deliberately expands the global denominator by 11,639 executable blueprint app/kit lines that the old 71% never measured. The final complete issue tree measures 63.05%, so the aggregate seeds at 62 with one point of runner/remapping headroom while the two newly visible scopes retain their own higher measured floors and ratchet upward. No previously instrumented file lost coverage. PR #638 re-seeds packages/vault and packages/gateway line floors 1pt under the honest measured tip (vault 87.7/73.9 → 87/73, gateway 79.9 → 79) after #630 vault expansion (locker-auth, schedule-organize, recurrence, household) diluted the old mainline 88/80 seeds; tests for those surfaces were added in the same change. #709 Binding Layer re-seed: packages/design/src lines 98→94 after CI verify run 30901194404 measured 95.1% (expanded token/kit surface diluted the prior toCss()-heavy floor from #565). Floor is ~1pt under measured with the same margin used elsewhere for measurement-driven reseeds. #781 floors the hand-authored recognition handler source (packages/model-runtime/automation-handlers/**) that the packages/model-runtime/src/** floor could never reach: measured 2026-08-14 at 83.28 lines / 80.44 branches over the five handlers with the new source-level suites in that directory, seeded the usual two points under at 81/78. #725 graduates Photos to its own scope and leaves a measured blend over _shared plus the seven non-graduated apps; measured 2026-08-08 at Photos 46.82/42.81 (floors 44/40) and blend 22.53/16.92 (floors 20/14). #781 second tree: floors the 23 hand-authored connector/enricher handlers under packages/blueprints/automations, measured 2026-08-15 at 92.64/71.76 with the in-tree source suites, seeded two points under at 90/69; the five generated recognition bundles are coverage-excluded (source-floored under packages/model-runtime/automation-handlers, drift-checked). #799 stage 6 removes the packages/design/kit/** floor scope (49/37) because the directory it floors no longer exists: the surviving element classes, DOM substrate, and sha256 hasher folded into packages/design/src/elements/** where the existing packages/design/src/** floor (94/70) governs them, and the rest of the kit was deleted as dead code. A scope ceasing to exist, not a floor lowering: every surviving line moved INTO the stricter scope. Measured on the merged tree before this edit landed. #839 Wave 0 (gap G14) graduates tasks, agenda, and notes out of the blended blueprint scope and floors apps/mobile for the first time. The blend key changes shape — `packages/blueprints/apps/{_shared,agenda,docs,locker,notes,people,tally,tasks}/**` is REPLACED by `packages/blueprints/apps/{_shared,docs,locker,people,tally}/**` — which the ratchet reads as a scope removal; nothing is weakened by it. Every tree the old key governed is still floored, and every floor over those trees RISES: the shrunken blend seeds at 41/33 against a measured 43.13/35.22, and the three graduated apps seed at tasks 37/25 (measured 39.36/27.76), agenda 40/30 (measured 42.27/32.47), notes 39/27 (measured 41.05/29.47) — all far above the 20/14 the blend guaranteed them, which was a #725-era seed the tree had long outgrown. No number decreases. Measured 2026-08-21 by a vitest run over the packages/blueprints and apps/mobile test files with the root config's repo-root coverage include (so untested files still count in every denominator), seeded the usual two points under. A path-filtered run can only UNDER-measure relative to the unified `bun run coverage` — cross-package suites add coverage, never remove it — so seeding under it is conservative in the same direction as the margin; for reference the full-run blend measurement recorded on #839 (42.21/33.08 over all eight trees) agrees with this run's 42.32/33.26 to within 0.2pt. apps/mobile is floored on its pure-logic surface only, matching the standing rule that mobile UI is owned by extracted logic plus journeys rather than a whole-surface line percentage: `apps/mobile/src/lib/**` at 56/48 (measured 58.12/50.65 over 81 files) and `apps/mobile/src/**/*-model.ts` at 86/72 (measured 88.62/74.26 over the 22 view-model modules). The two keys deliberately overlap on `src/lib/notification-model.ts`; vitest resolves each threshold glob into its own coverage map, so an overlap double-counts one file's lines across two independent floors rather than confusing either.
